title: Photo 129 · 머슬 아워글래스 BBW · 알레브리헤 · 무릎 꿇기 3/4 (양 무릎) · 라틴 20대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Latina woman in her late 20s, warm golden-tan skin tone with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a high bun with a jewelled pin, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears large hoop earrings and has long glossy almond nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. Huge rounded shoulders and massive thick arms with the swell of the biceps and triceps showing through a soft layer of fat, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — a shadowed groove running around her middle, the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward, the muscle of her core firm beneath it. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops straight down from it under its own weight, projecting far forward past the line of her own knees before it falls, settling onto the tops of her thighs and piling over them, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds as it falls, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, a gigantic powerful rear, colossal thighs with the great sweep of the quads visible under a soft layer, thick heavy calves with a diamond shape showing through, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Wide at the bust, drawn in at the waistline, wide again below: the silhouette reads as a great hourglass at the most extreme size. Powerful and heavy at once, no bodybuilder leanness, the weight of the flesh visible in how it hangs over the muscle beneath. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is young and firm for its size, each fold holding a taut rounded shape. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it drops, settles and presses down onto the thighs beneath it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Oaxacan alebrije style — her own skin tone as the base colour, densely painted with vivid neon magenta, yellow, lime green, turquoise and orange dots, stripes, zigzags and small flowers, a bright striped band following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, no animal figures. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Kneeling upright on the platform and turned about 45 degrees from the camera with the front of her body still mostly toward the lens, her face toward the camera, both shins and feet folded back beneath her and her weight settled onto her heels, her knees wide apart, her back straight, her near hand resting on her thigh and her far arm held back so nothing crosses in front of her torso, the enormous rounded rear settling back onto her heels seen in partial profile, full body head to knees filling the frame.

Footwear: Extreme magenta platform stiletto mules, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the neon colours blazing, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
